studies.P: Product choice with competent unrestricted direct workflow under equal resources
studies.S: Strict semantic authoring coverage; Semwright mutations through Broker capabilities

unknown_cost_policy: null plus reason; never replace with zero
setup_policy: Equivalent pinned runtime provisioning, cold and warm separate, integration/setup costs separately recorded
order_policy: Task/study/seed paired, deterministic randomized arm order
replica_policy: Seeds fixed before measurement; one replica is exploratory, no population significance claim
baseline_policy: Direct arm may use competent code, modules, native APIs, tests, docs and visual tools; same model and task outputs
holdout_policy: Public development tasks are never final holdouts; fresh reserved instances prepared before technical freeze; seal/reveal ledger required
visual_quality_policy: Blind human assessment only when actually available; absent judgments stay unknown
source_policy: Immutable frozen product and suite; no product repair or hidden benchmark helpers during evaluation
model_policy: No API calls until provider, model, comparable sessions and paid quota use are explicitly authorized/configured
